digest.component_or_area: Cloud Jira rich text codec (ADF Markdown conversion)
propositions: ADF encode must be Markdown-aware to preserve structured nodes (headings, lists, code blocks, inline marks) rather than emitting literal syntax characters
Round-trip idempotence requires a mark-order canonicalizer to eliminate the 2-cycle alternation between combined strong+strikethrough orderings
HTML comments in source text are dropped by marklas and must be recovered via self-verification decoding, falling back to plain encode if loss occurs

Markdown-aware functions are provided as pure capabilities with lazy-import of optional marklas/mistune extras, degrading to plain-text adf.py when unavailable, preserving the stdlib-only engine contract
The committed corpus fixture of 360 stratified bodies measures 100% idempotence fixed-point and 15.6% structural richness under the explicit block-node predicate
AdfCodec and its four operations remain untouched pass-throughs; nothing observable changes on merge
